description: List the user's in-app notifications, newest first. Pass filter='unread' to scope to unread items (use this to answer 'do I have any new notifications?'). Each notification has a `type`, an optional `deepLink`, and a `metadata` JSON blob whose shape varies by type. Returns up to `limit` items (default 20, max 50) with a `nextCursor` for pagination.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — id of the last seen notification.

filter.description: Filter by read state. Default: all.

limit.description: Number of notifications to return (default 20, max 50).

name: list_notifications
